notes.title: Elaria: The Corrupted Throne is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Elaria: The Corrupted Throne is out now on Steam! After a year of hard work, you can now dive into the old school adventure in the lands of Elaria. Dive into dungeons, mix & match gear into powerful builds, master the local trading card game, or jump head first into the main campaign. 

This development journey has been full of learning and I want to give a big thank you to everyone who offered feedback so far to help make Elaria what it is today. Thank you!!!

notes.title: Elaria's Demo Extended for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
From 9-16 October, the demo for Elaria: The Corrupted Throne will be extended to a full hour! Players will be able to explore the first island, take on quests, defeat dungeon bosses, and gather loot. And of course, the progress you make in the demo carries over into the full game!

Have a happy Steam Next Fest and don't forget, Elaria is releasing right after the festival ends on 16 October. Wishlist today!

notes.title: Elaria Has A Release Date!
notes.notes:
After 14 months of development, my first ever game will enter the Steam marketplace! Elaria: The Corrupted Throne will be participating in Steam Next Fest from 9 Oct - 16 Oct and it would mean a lot to me if everyone could check out the demo and add Elaria to their wishlist. If you don't know already, this greatly helps Elaria to be seen by more people on Steam.

As soon as the Steam Next Fest ends, Elaria: The Corrupted Throne will be releasing at [b]10:00 am, 16 October 2023[/b]. I'm super excited for people to see what I've been working on, and a HUGE thank you to everyone who encouraged me throughout this journey.

notes.title: Elaria: The Corrupted Throne Demo
notes.notes: You can dive into the world of [b]Elaria [/b]right now with my brand new timed, 20-minute demo! Head over to the store page to get it downloaded. You can replay the demo as many times as you want and even pick up where you left off when the full game comes out, enjoy!
